data.one_liner: A Flutter widget implementing a backdrop displaying contextual and actionable content.
data.what_it_does: Implements a slide-up panel and backdrop over a body widget, similar to the Spotify mobile app interface. It supports customizable headers, footers, app bars, blur effects, overlays, and animations.
use_when: You need a slide-up panel or sheet similar to music player interfaces
You want a backdrop with contextual and actionable content over a main body
avoid_when: You only need standard modal bottom sheets provided by Flutter material
You need complex nested routing handled inside the panel
strengths: Supports custom animations, blur effects, overlays, and parallax
Provides built-in options for footers, appbars, and headers
weaknesses: Documentation outside of the properties table is sparse
data.minimal_example:
WeSlide(
  panelMinSize: 70.0,
  panelMaxSize: 200.0,
  body: Container(color: Colors.white),
  panel: Container(color: Colors.blue),
)
